//: Type-checking for the dashboard TypeScript source. Full `strict` is ON — that subsumes noImplicitAny + strictNullChecks plus strictFunctionTypes, useUnknownInCatchVariables (catch vars are `unknown`: narrow with `err instanceof Error ? err.message : ...`), noImplicitThis, etc. Every value needs a determinable type and every possibly-null/undefined access must be guarded or narrowed. tsc emits nothing; this is a checker only. Run via `npm run typecheck`.
